assumptions: Harbor/Docker grades only Python ETL via pytest -q /grader/tests. Node/Next.js is not scored.
Frontend visual quality is subjective and is not a mandatory automated requirement.
Quarantine reason text may vary; tests only require conflict/duplicate wording where specified.
CLI wording may vary as long as documented field labels are present.

optional_or_human.behavior: Control-center aesthetics, typography, and animation taste.
optional_or_human.verification: Human visual review only. Automated tests cannot prove design quality.

requirement_mapping.behavior: Duplicate events are handled globally across files; one logical row per event_id.
Conflicting reuse of an event_id does not overwrite the original row; the conflict is quarantined.
Malformed records are quarantined; valid siblings still load.
Monetary values are aggregated as exact integer minor units.
Timezone-aware timestamps normalize to UTC; naive timestamps are quarantined.
Additive unknown schema fields do not reject a valid event.
Late-arriving records update historical UTC metrics without changing later days.
Interrupted ingestion recovers to the same warehouse as a clean run.
A file is not recorded as successfully processed until ingestion finishes safely.
New files ingest incrementally; pre-existing warehouse rows are not wiped.
Same filename with changed bytes is new input; event_id rules still apply.
CLI remains functional and prints documented run/status fields.
Dashboard remains functional and run/status/health use the pipeline.
Happy-path ingestion of a valid file loads events, metrics, and a completed run.
Independent oracle on a seeded multi-file dataset including extras, duplicates, and late rows.
